scope: Read-only offline primary-asset resolution. No native or Drive integration.

api.manifestMutability: Private constructor; all caller collections copied with bounded enumeration before first await; sealed immutable records; read-only collections; stable SHA256 over identities, verified hashes, roots, order, flags and limits.

providerOrder: RetailPackage: declared order, exact digest then final-component ASCII lowercase within each provider

decodeRules.loose: Plain bytes, no transform or inflate. Empty selected files reject.
decodeRules.raw: Standalone bounded record, decode enabled; platform transform flag independently applied. No fabricated HED.
decodeRules.retail: Per-provider DecodeEnabled; false reads rawSize unchanged and disables transform/inflate.
decodeRules.tiny: rawSize <=16 bypasses transform/inflate. Effective reader rejects zero; legacy archive zero-size behavior is preserved.
decodeRules.positive: Decoded providers with rawSize>16 stream positive mode bytes through optional prefix transform then exact zlib + Adler32/trailer/padding checks.
decodeRules.minusOne: Decoded providers with rawSize>16 apply prefix transform unless disabled.
decodeRules.otherMode: Rejected, including zero and unknown negative modes.
decodeRules.remasters: All declared metadata and physical spans checked. Only primary payload decoded; no semantic remaster safety claim.

bounds.hedMetadata: Aggregate bounded by MaximumMetadataBytes; each provider row count bounded by MaximumIndexEntries.
bounds.recordMetadata: 16+48*count with wide arithmetic, MaximumMetadataBytes/MaximumBarEntries, physical spans within record.
bounds.decodedBytes: MaximumDecodedBytes before allocation; encoded input streamed.
bounds.barDepth: No BAR recursion in this reader; limits are validated. Existing bounded AssetArchiveReader retains recursive BAR API.

identitiesAndProvenance: Windows file volume/index/creation/write/size stamps; HED and provider/configuration SHA256 verified each read; files and ancestor directory handles held through publication.
Result includes selected identity, provider kind/ordinal, matched name bytes, HED ordinal and record offset where applicable, metadata SHA256, decoded SHA256 and manifest SHA256.
Loose metadata hash is SHA256 of empty bytes (no record metadata).
Only absent or directory loose candidates advance. Existing unreadable/invalid/empty sources, selected duplicate HED digests, changed identities, checksum errors and limits throw without fallback.
All higher-priority absent/directory candidates rechecked before return; observed change rejects output.
Every manifest provider is revalidated, including lower providers when an override wins; stale manifests fail conservatively.

exceptions.NotSupportedException: Unknown provider fingerprint; unsupported/ambiguous non-ASCII, unresolved or remote path policy.
exceptions.InvalidDataException: Malformed bounds/record/selected duplicate/empty source/path component or invalid metadata.
exceptions.IOException: Sharing/access/source identity or content changes (including derived file and directory errors).
exceptions.FileNotFoundException: No selected provider contains name; also stale required manifest file.

limitations: OfflineManifestBinding is unconditional. Exact supported binaries and disk roots do not prove loaded hooks, cached package metadata, startup fake-package ownership, current native prefix or provider configuration.

The manifest describes caller-declared roots and order; it does not discover a running process or parse/attest its settings. Optional configuration evidence fingerprints bind documents, not runtime adoption.

A final absence recheck is not an atomic namespace snapshot. A higher-priority file can appear after that check. Ordinary read-sharing/directory handles do not establish a guarantee against all filesystem or memory-mapped writers.

PKG files are bound by file identity/size/timestamps, not whole multi-gigabyte content hashes. Selected record metadata and returned decoded content are hashed; the result certifies its owned copy, not future file contents.

ASCII-only names, fully qualified local UTF16 roots already ending in kh2; reparse/device/UNC/ADS/traversal/ambiguous Windows names rejected. No relative-root auto-resolution or locale-dependent fallback.
Successful primary decoding does not validate BAR/model/bone/MSET/remaster semantics or native allocations. No bytes are passed to native loaders or used to authorize Drive.
Internal friend-assembly hooks substitute temporary fixture fingerprints and inject a pre-publication test callback; the public production API exposes neither bypass.

verification.fixtures: Temporary synthetic files only; existing Core tests retained; no retail/game/mod/save data writes or live game calls.

testsCovered: Five provider levels and raw precedence; selected corruption/access failure without lower fallback; directory candidate behavior.
Exact per-provider basename fallback, directory byte case, selected duplicate exact/fallback digest, provider identity duplication and order hashing.

Standalone 0/2-remaster layouts; modes -2/-1/positive; zero/16/17-byte originals; decode/transform flags separated; golden prefix/zlib vectors; malformed/overlap/truncated metadata and physical spans.
Checksum/trailer/decoded-length/padding failures; short-read streams; 64-bit bad offsets; decoded/table/count/aggregate limits.

Immutable caller lists including dishonest Count; same-time config/HED/DLL changes; same-time file replacement; sharing locks and release; higher-priority appearance; Unicode roots and strict name policy; cancellation and deterministic manifest hashes.

independentReview.rootReview: Parent also inspected bounded decode, precedence, immutable manifest, hashes, rechecks and no fallback; no additional finding.
independentReview.fixedFinding: Canonical // and mixed-separator UNC paths could normalize to a remote path before the filesystem guard. Raw two-separator and canonical UNC/device guards now run before any filesystem probe; seven deterministic path regressions pass.
